## Summary
Build the faculty invitation flow: admin enters faculty email, Supabase sends magic link invite, faculty completes onboarding and is assigned the faculty role within the admin's institution.

## User story
As an admin, I want to invite faculty members by email, so that they can join my institution and begin managing courses and assessments.

## Why this matters
Faculty members are the primary content creators in Journey OS. Without a working invite flow, no one can upload lectures, review assessment items, or manage courses. A broken invite (wrong institution_id, missing role) means faculty see an empty dashboard or worse, access another institution's data (FERPA violation).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Admin can enter one or more faculty emails and send invitations
- [ ] Invitation creates a pending record in faculty_invitations table
- [ ] Supabase Auth sends magic link to invited email
- [ ] When faculty clicks link, they are onboarded with role='faculty' and correct institution_id
- [ ] Faculty list page shows all faculty (active + pending) for the institution
- [ ] Admin can revoke a pending invitation
- [ ] Duplicate email invitation for same institution returns friendly error (not crash)
- [ ] RLS ensures faculty invitations are scoped to admin's institution_id

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Data Layer (AP-17) | supabase.rpc() for atomic invite creation (invitation record + auth invite) |
| Data Layer (AP-16) | Row<'faculty_invitations'>, Row<'profiles'> from @journey/db/client |
| Atomic Design | FacultyInviteForm + FacultyList are organisms in features/admin/components/ |
| RLS | faculty_invitations scoped by institution_id — admin can only see own institution's invites |

## Schema changes
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.faculty_invitations (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.institutions(id),
  email TEXT NOT NULL,
  invited_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'revoked', 'expired')),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT (now() + INTERVAL '7 days'),
  accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  UNIQUE (institution_id, email)
);

ALTER TABLE public.faculty_invitations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Admins can manage invitations for own institution"
  ON public.faculty_invitations FOR ALL
  USING (institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()));
```

## API contract
```
POST /app/api/admin/faculty
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Request: { emails: string[] }
Response 200: { data: { invited: string[], failed: { email: string, reason: string }[] }, error: null }
Response 401: { data: null, error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: string } }
Response 403: { data: null, error: { code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin role required' } }

GET /app/api/admin/faculty
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response 200: { data: { faculty: Array<{ id, email, role, status, invited_at }> }, error: null }

DELETE /app/api/admin/faculty/[id]
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response 200: { data: { revoked: true }, error: null }
Response 404: { data: null, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: string } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/admin/services/FacultyService.ts
import { createServerClient, Row } from '@journey/db/client';

type FacultyInvitation = Row<'faculty_invitations'>;

export class FacultyService {
  async inviteFaculty(emails: string[]): Promise<{ invited: string[]; failed: { email: string; reason: string }[] }> {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
      emails.map(async (email) => {
        // AP-17: use RPC for atomic invite + auth
        const { error } = await supabase.rpc('invite_faculty', { p_email: email });
        if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
        return email;
      })
    );
    // Process settled results...
  }
}

// app/(admin)/faculty/page.tsx — < 30 lines
import { FacultyInviteForm } from '@/features/admin/components/FacultyInviteForm';
import { FacultyList } from '@/features/admin/components/FacultyList';
export default function FacultyPage() {
  return (
    <>
      <FacultyInviteForm />
      <FacultyList />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ AP-17: Sequential inserts for atomic operations
await supabase.from('faculty_invitations').insert({ email });
await supabase.auth.admin.inviteUserByEmail(email); // BANNED — not atomic
// ✓ Use: supabase.rpc('invite_faculty', { p_email: email })

// ✗ Rule 3: Promise.all for batch operations
await Promise.all(emails.map(inviteFn)); // BANNED — one failure kills all
// ✓ Use: Promise.allSettled(emails.map(inviteFn))
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E02/E02-S03.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('POST /api/admin/faculty invites faculty members', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post('/api/admin/faculty', {
    data: { emails: ['faculty1@msm.edu', 'faculty2@msm.edu'] }
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const body = await res.json();
  expect(body.data.invited).toHaveLength(2);
  expect(body.data.failed).toHaveLength(0);
});

test('POST /api/admin/faculty rejects duplicate invitation', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post('/api/admin/faculty', {
    data: { emails: ['faculty1@msm.edu'] } // already invited above
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const body = await res.json();
  expect(body.data.failed).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(body.data.failed[0].reason).toContain('already invited');
});

test('GET /api/admin/faculty lists all faculty for institution', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/faculty');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const body = await res.json();
  expect(body.data.faculty.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
});

test('DELETE /api/admin/faculty/[id] revokes pending invitation', async ({ request }) => {
  // Get a pending invitation ID first
  const listRes = await request.get('/api/admin/faculty');
  const { data } = await listRes.json();
  const pending = data.faculty.find((f: any) => f.status === 'pending');
  if (pending) {
    const res = await request.delete(`/api/admin/faculty/${pending.id}`);
    expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  }
});

test('POST /api/admin/faculty returns 403 for non-admin', async ({ request }) => {
  // Using a faculty-role session (from test fixtures)
  const res = await request.post('/api/admin/faculty', {
    data: { emails: ['test@msm.edu'] }
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(403);
});

// tests/E02/E02-S03.ui.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Faculty page shows invite form and faculty list', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/faculty');
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: /faculty/i })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByPlaceholder(/email/i)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /invite/i })).toBeVisible();
});
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.faculty_invitations CASCADE; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.invite_faculty;`
2. No Neo4j changes to revert.
3. `git stash && git checkout develop`
